crossRefs.note: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;
The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.
He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which…
The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.
The friendship of Yahweh is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise…
He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

translations.web: For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.
translations.bsb: for the LORD detests the perverse, but He is a friend to the upright.
translations.kjv: For the froward is abomination to the LORD: but his secret is with the righteous.
translations.asv: For the perverse is an abomination to Jehovah; But his friendship is with the upright.
